name: Pagination
summary: A page selector for a paged list or table — prev / numbered pages with ellipsis / next.
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-pagination> — defined once, imported unchanged by React and Vue. Shadow-DOM CSS, themed only by --aha-* tokens; give it `total`, `page-size` and `current` and it renders prev / numbered pages (ellipsis for long ranges) / next. The current page is brand-filled; hover animates via the shared motion tokens on persistent nodes; prev/next use the DS caret glyph via <aha-icon>. Emits a composed `change` event.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) consumes it via a thin wrapper that listens for `change`; Vue binds the custom element natively. The primitive is defined once in @ahaslides-product/design.

props.name: total
props.desc: Total item count across all pages

props.name: page-size
props.desc: Items per page; total ÷ page-size decides the page count

props.name: current
props.desc: The active page (1-based); reflected as it changes

props.name: change
props.desc: Composed event on page change, detail { page }

whenToUse.when: a long list or table is split into pages the user steps through
a feed the user grazes — not a set they navigate by position
occasional appends where exact page position doesn't matter

opinion.note: Show pagination only when there is more than one page. Keep page cells on the 32px square + radius-8 scale, and reserve the brand fill for the current page. The last/first ellipsis keeps long ranges compact.
opinion.dsv3: COVERED — DS V3 has no measured Pagination cell; spec derived from the token layer (white rest, border #E3E3E3, color-primary current fill, text-inverse label, radius-default 8) + AntD Pagination conventions (32px cells, ellipsis for long ranges, disabled prev/next). Motion + arrow glyphs bound to the shared motion tokens and the DS icon library.

snippets.note: The native form — a web component in an HTML file renders on open, no build step. The fast path for vibe-coding.
